args.text:
name: Venice bridge transport proof
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  download-proof:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - name: Download current repo instructions
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, urllib.request
          url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/main/TODO.md'
          data = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30).read()
          assert b'## Venice' in data
          open('TODO.downloaded.md', 'wb').write(data)
          json.dump({'source': url, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}, open('download-proof.json', 'w'), indent=2)
          print('Verified download:', len(data), 'bytes')
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: venice-bridge-download-proof
          path: |
            TODO.downloaded.md
            download-proof.json
          retention-days: 3
args.message: venice: isolated three-minute contents-read download proof
